note: Two planned candidates for provider calibration, not anatomical approval. Uses existing canonical exercise 0001. No paid generation authorized.

poses.caption: Start
poses.description: Lie supine on mat, knees bent, soles flat, hands resting lightly behind head, elbows comfortably open.

poses.caption: Partial sit-up
poses.description: Same feet and pelvis position. Raise trunk only to approximately 45 degrees, with controlled spinal flexion. Hands remain light; do not pull head or neck. Do not show a full upright sit-up.

jobs.techniqueNotes: Canonical 3/4 sit-up, not a crunch or full sit-up. Use a side-oblique camera with both knees, heels, pelvis and spine visible. Keep feet grounded, cervical spine comfortable, avoid jerking. Male wears opaque training top, fully enclosed knee-length athletic shorts and shoes in both poses. Qualified review must check catalog terminology and range before publication.
jobs.muscleNotes: Catalog target is abs. Red rectus-abdominis region overlay on intact opaque top; do not expose fibers through fabric. Hip flexors and lower back are catalog secondary labels, not primary red highlights. Detailed muscle map absent: qualified review pending.
